svg.text: READING KEY — how to read the exhibit faces
Every mark on the per-line exhibits, drawn once with its meaning. Each exhibit footer points here (“key: KEY_exhibit_reading_guide_0728_62”).

Colours (hers, fixed): orange = token things (top-tok cell / dot / highlight) · field hue = line things (the z dot + z-cut) · channel colours (field hue / amber / purple) live inside the investigation cells only · sign lives in numbers and positions, never in a colour.
z-cut ·ADOPTED
THE SCALAR BAR = TWO strips. UPPER = token tier: centre tick, cut dash(es), and the orange top-tok dot (the |Δ|-max token, sign kept). LOWER = z tier:
the line-scalar as a news-normed z. The raw line-scalar reading is NOT on the face — it lives in the sidecar .model.json (her ruling A, raw dot
retires).
CUT DASH, SALIENCE panels {color, plant, sound} — the POSITIVE dash ALONE. Under the v5.0 positive-only trigger law a negative Δ on a salience axis is
dilution, never an event; so the strip's one firing boundary is the positive cut (linegrain_law_60.SALIENCE_TRIGGER_FIELDS).
CUT DASH, VALUE panels {illumination dark+, temporal long+} — BOTH dashes. Two-sided remains their trigger law: a large negative excursion on a signed
value axis IS a salient reading of the opposite pole (“saliently short/bright”). (temporal carries no cut, so it draws zero dashes.)
z DOT SATURATION = the field's battery grade (the muted dot's true reason, shown as itself). .95 = DISCRIMINATION at line grain (colour) · .85 =
temporal (ρ .860, a distinct credential, declared) · .55 = WEAK exploratory (plant, sound). The z strip is fixed ±3σ, 0 = the language's news mean.
(no z strip below — one sentence instead)
SUPPRESSED z (her ruling B): a field graded “NO demonstrated discrimination” (illumination, exam .427) draws NO z strip at all — no dot, label,
baseline or tick. In its place the panel carries ONE sentence: “line-scalar suppressed: no line-tier discrimination at grade (exam .427) — see
instruments prose”. A chance-like z belongs in prose, not the diagram.
z-cut ·ADOPTED
THE COLOUR z-CUT LINE (·ADOPTED, z = +1.5485). A dashed vertical on the colour z strip at the 95th percentile of the UNFIRED colour z (pooled
en/zh/de/fr, positive side). A dot RIGHT of it reads “relatively colourful vs the census unfired baseline (above 95% of boolean-unfired lines)” —
NEVER proof of colour. Drawn only on DISCRIMINATION-graded fields (today colour). Makes NO states. A p95 convention, not a validated boundary.
untested (no news norm)
UNTESTED-BAR = the z strip is empty because the seat's language has NO news norm (jp; any language outside {en,zh,de,fr}). A crossed box + “untested
(no news norm)”. The token-tier strip still renders. This is ‘not measured (no norm)’ — distinct from the suppressed case above (‘measured,
chance-like’).
untested
UNTESTED-BOX = an investigation cell for a channel that does NOT exist on that seat (the channel was never consulted): a pale diagonal cross-out box +
“untested”. It is visibly DISTINCT from a tested-null cell “—” (the channel WAS consulted and nothing fired).
★ = the ESCAPE column (outside the token-grain box by law). A crossing is starred SUGGESTIVE when a state-bearing side is a borrowed-cut 2-state
(present*/silent*: the WORD channel is uncovered) — a demonstrative crossing whose evidence is thinner than a full-stack one. (The fr token-ghost star
RETIRED, #62 — see the badge below.)
° = UNTRIGGERED / mechanical view. The top-tok's |Δ| did not reach the cut, so its cell is a pale mechanical reading (the top-tok is shown regardless;
the ring says it did not fire).
rid ⟨MT⟩
⟨MT⟩ (grey italic) = a MACHINE-translation control seat (google / mt_*). Rendered grey-italic so a machine control never reads as a human translator.
zh:… (a full-stack seat)
▪ = FULL-STACK BADGE (her reversal ruling, #62: “zh is terrific and we have the full support here!”). A small neutral-dark square before the seat rid
marks a seat whose language has word · written · referent channels ALL running (today Chinese, LAW.FULL_STACK_LANGS). The referent miners are
Chinese-side only; where that channel runs it alters 2 of 669 word-tier-silent verdicts (0.3%) — real but thin. Non-Chinese seats' investigations are
word-tier (and, for German and French, colour-only); their thinness is carried in prose, never a star.
rid (dropped …)
rid (unaligned …)
STATUS ROWS (grey italic, no data cells). DROPPED = the translator renders nothing for this source line (PI-approved alignment map, seat=[]).
UNALIGNED = the seat has no alignment file yet (line-number pairing is navigation, not an alignment claim). Neither is ever crossed as data.

Spec: EXHIBIT_SPEC_v4_0728_60 (the drawing law) · law module: linegrain_law_60 (marks single-sourced) · generated: key_gen_62.py, 2026-07-28 (#62). Data era: census v5.1 (findings_v51 — fr token-ghost star retired).

Her rulings behind these marks (#62): the salience trigger flip (positive-only) · the raw dot retires (A) · chance-like z suppressed (B) · the colour z-cut ADOPTED · the cut-dash side ruling (salience one-sided) · THE STAR REVERSAL (the fr deficiency star → the zh full-stack badge; thinness in prose).
Display/annotation marks (z dot, z-cut line, untested-bar, badge, ★) make NO states — the census, the false-fire budget and the verse-null cut are untouched by any mark on this key.
